systems.name: Public Employees' Retirement System of Mississippi
systems.why: No Mississippi statute index on this copy of lexflow (the system is in Miss. Code Ann. Title 25, ch. 11, art. 3; citation not verified here).

source.quote: The Board is responsible for designating the System’s executive director and for establishing the policies for administration of the trust.

website_source.quote: PERS was established in 1952 as the retirement system for state agencies, as well as counties, cities, and other participating political subdivisions.

covers_local_source.quote: PERS was established in 1952 as the retirement system for state agencies, as well as counties, cities, and other participating political subdivisions.

systems.notes: Covers state, public school, university, community college, county and municipal employees and legislators. Tier 5 hybrid plan for members hired March 1, 2026 and later.

systems.name: Mississippi Highway Safety Patrol Retirement System
systems.why: No Mississippi statute index on this copy of lexflow (the system is in Miss. Code Ann. Title 25, ch. 13; citation not verified here).

source.quote: The Board is responsible for designating the System’s executive director and for establishing the policies for administration of the trust.

website_source.quote: MHSPRS was established in 1958 as the retirement system for all of the sworn officers of the Mississippi Highway Safety Patrol who have completed a course of instruction in an authorized Highway Patrol Training School on general law enforcement.

systems.name: Supplemental Legislative Retirement Plan
systems.why: No Mississippi statute index on this copy of lexflow (the plan is in Miss. Code Ann. Title 25, ch. 11, art. 7; citation not verified here).

source.quote: The Board is responsible for designating the System’s executive director and for establishing the policies for administration of the trust.

website_source.quote: Established in 1989, SLRP provides supplemental benefits, in addition to PERS benefits, to all members of the Mississippi Legislature and the Lieutenant Governor.

systems.notes: Administered by PERS; the PERS home page reports that House Bill 1 (2026) closed SLRP to newly elected legislators.

systems.name: Municipal Retirement Systems

body.name: PERS, with the governing authorities of the respective cities

source.quote: MRS are closed plans administered by PERS since July 1, 1987, in coordination with the governing authorities of the respective cities.

covers_local_source.quote: MRS are closed plans administered by PERS since July 1, 1987, in coordination with the governing authorities of the respective cities.
